bends.reason: Long-edge flange of the left (end) strip. In the raw TOP view the strip segment has its own edge-on dark flange lines on both long edges (raw x~1388-1470). A flange-free gap (the unfolded wall) separates them from the main-plate flanges. The raw FRONT view (and the overlay FRONT view) shows this flange band folded. In bend_01 the scan points sit on the blue short flange (~13 mm, ~90 deg); the orange position is empty.

Main-plate long-edge flange. The raw TOP view shows an edge-on flange line along the whole main-plate length. Raw FRONT shows the flange band and raw SIDE shows the down-turned channel leg. In bend_02 the scan follows the blue profile: the flange pieces, including the gaps where the CAD has holes, the parent, and the slot-tab V at ~30 mm. The orange position is empty.

End flange of the left strip. The raw TOP view shows no edge-on line at that end: ~16 mm of flat material runs past where the strip flanges end. Raw FRONT shows no upturn at the plate end and raw SIDE shows no face-on flange band. In bend_03 the scan lies on the orange straight continuation (~12 mm) and the blue position is empty.

This is the lower bend of the Z-step (wall to left strip). The scan is one flat plane through the whole step region. Raw FRONT shows a single straight plate line and raw SIDE shows no wall face. The overlay shows the scan continuing flat beyond B11 while the CAD step hangs below it. In bend_04 the scan follows the orange flat continuation for the full ~58 mm and the blue leg is empty.

End wing of the bottom-slot tab: a short (~7 mm) wing bent ~35 deg about a line across the standing tab, near the slot's chamfered end. In the raw TOP view, the edge-on tab line at that slot has a distinct outward kink at its arrow-shaped end, so the wing is out of the tab plane. The CAD shows its wing going outward in the same direction. In bend_05 the scan follows the blue kinked child along the ~79 mm tab, not the orange straight one.

Bottom-slot tab standing at the slot edge. The raw TOP view shows the slot open with a dense edge-on tab line along its edge. Raw SIDE shows the upward stub (opposite side from the flanges) and raw FRONT shows the tab band. In bend_06 the scan sits on the blue ~90 deg tab (~14 mm). The orange flat position inside the slot is empty.

End wing of the top-slot tab, the counterpart of B5. In the raw TOP view the edge-on tab line kinks outward at the slot's arrow-shaped end, in the same direction as the CAD wing. In bend_07 the scan follows the blue ~35 deg kink of the ~7 mm child, not the orange straight continuation.

Top-slot tab standing at the slot edge. The raw TOP view shows the slot open with an edge-on tab line, and raw SIDE shows the upward stub. In bend_08 the scan follows the blue profile within ~1-2 mm: the tab goes down-left ~90 deg and the B10 flange shows the V. The orange flat-tab position is empty.

Long-edge flange of the left strip on the other edge. In the raw TOP view the strip segment (raw x~1388-1470) shows an edge-on flange line, and the raw ISO view shows the raised flange on that edge beyond the gap. In bend_09 the scan child is bent ~80-90 deg in the blue direction. It is offset ~3 mm from the blue (the strip is displaced because the step is unformed) but is clearly not on the orange.

Main-plate long-edge flange on the second edge. The raw TOP view shows an edge-on flange line along the main-plate length, and raw SIDE shows the down-turned leg. In bend_10 the scan follows the blue profile: the flange pieces with the hole gaps, the parent, and the top-slot tab V. The orange position is empty.

This is the upper bend of the Z-step (main plate to wall). No wall is present: raw FRONT is one straight plate line and raw SIDE has no ~42 mm face. The flange gap left in raw TOP at the wall position lies flat in plane. In bend_11 the scan lies exactly on the orange flat continuation for the full ~100 mm and the blue 90 deg leg is empty.

Main-plate end flange. In the raw TOP view there is no edge-on line at that end. The plate runs ~3 mm past the ends of the long-edge flanges, with corner notches, which matches the flat flat-pattern tab. Raw FRONT and SIDE show no end flange. In bend_12 the scan lies on the orange straight continuation (~10 mm) and the blue position is empty.
